prompt:
Production sprite sheet for a 2D cartoon cel-shaded collecting game. EXACTLY 12 separate object icons arranged in a precise 4-column by 3-row evenly spaced grid. Each object is centered in its own equal 384x341 cell, takes at most 72 percent of cell width and height, fully contained with wide empty gutters. NO visible grid. Transparent alpha background, absolutely NO scenery, background, floor, pedestal, cast shadow, checkerboard, labels, words, letters, captions, watermarks or UI.
ART DIRECTION: bold clean hand-drawn anime cel-shaded inventory icons, simple playful chunky silhouettes. Thick dark navy outer contour, very few interior lines. Only 3 to 5 flat color areas per object, TWO-TONE hard-edged cel shadows and at most one broad highlight. Slight 3/4 view, charming stylized proportions. Readable at 48 pixels. Think polished vector-like cartoon stickers, not realistic illustrations. No realistic metal, glass refraction, texture, wear, grain, scratches, tiny buttons, detailed strings, micro-details, photorealism, 3D render, gradients or painterly lighting. Colored silhouettes must dominate. Every item equally important, consistent line width. Do not connect any items or add decorative effects between cells.
Exact left-to-right row-major order:
Row 1, column 1: a chunky orange pocket radio with one large blue tuning dial.
Row 1, column 2: a single turquoise floppy disk.
Row 1, column 3: a small purple pager with simple green screen.
Row 1, column 4: a cream and red retro camera with one big dark lens.
Row 2, column 1: a mint handheld game console with two chunky buttons.
Row 2, column 2: a yellow cassette walkman with visible cassette window.
Row 2, column 3: pink cat-ear over-ear headphones.
Row 2, column 4: a squat blue CRT television with two short antennae.
Row 3, column 1: a simple red retro typewriter with a single blank page.
Row 3, column 2: a cyan space communicator with an oversized orange antenna.
Row 3, column 3: a purple translucent handheld console with simple visible big shapes.
Row 3, column 4: an iconic white cube computer with a single glowing orange eye.
